label: 灰残晶 / Gray Crystals

references.role: Tunigi Hollow gameplay capture; large irregular gray-blue slabs growing diagonally out of sandstone, with smaller shards near the base.
Cave gameplay screenshot showing the Gray Crystals tutorial objective and low, broken crystal surfaces. Cave lighting and characters were ignored.
Approach screenshot: the small crystals near the opening confirm a smaller prop can be placed without making a large wall. Overlay arrow and UI serve no visual role in the prop.

generation.prompt: Make one small isolated 2D pixel-art scenery prop for a MapleStory-inspired side-scrolling RPG: a cluster of the gray crystals (灰残晶) at Tunigi Hollow in Genshin Impact. Reference 1 is the primary reference: use only the long asymmetric slate-blue opaque crystal plates growing diagonally out of the brown cliff (upper right and lower right), with their irregular elongated ridges and sharp ragged tips. Reference 2 is supplemental for shallow broken faces and scattered slabs, not for the cave lighting. Create a compact cluster of 3 or 4 fused irregular tabular blades with one long tallest blade tilted up and to the left, uneven stepped tips, subdued cool slate blue-gray and muted gray-lilac facets, worn non-glowing stone, with a few rusty tan grit pixels tightly at the base so it fits the sand. Readable dark blue-gray outline and deliberate chunky pixel steps at roughly 60 to 90 pixels tall. Side-on orthographic 2D prop with a level bottom baseline, natural asymmetric silhouette, no background terrain, no ground plane or cast shadow, no arrow, no red circles, no text, no HUD, no characters, no plants, no free-floating particles, no sparkles, no glow, no bright gems, no gradients outside silhouette. Keep the complete prop centered with generous true transparent margins. One cluster only.

placement.layer: Host scenery after parallax background and before terrain and actors
placement.native3D: Visual reference for future scenery placement. These are lab pixel coordinates and visual scales; native asset, position, rotation and scale need separate authoring.

limits: One image reused at three scales and mirrored for the central cluster; no source model or rear faces inspected.
These lab props have no collision or interaction. Gray Crystal removal and native map layout remain outside this prototype.
